title: Nine Days by the Telephone
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决策）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决策）　|　核心词汇：test　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 test 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There was a ① test on the Monday, and everybody in the class had revised for it for a month, and my sister had not, because on the Thursday before, our mother had had a ② test at the hospital and the results were due on the Monday too. My sister sat the test and was top of the class, and I have never understood how.

The ③ test at the hospital was simple: eleven vials, one number, and a wait of nine days. My sister said the wait was not a ④ test of anything except sitting still, and that anybody can sit still if they have practised, and that she had had eleven years of practice by then.

They ⑤ tested us at school every week for two years, and the results went on a board in the corridor, and my sister's name was at the top of it for eleven weeks running. It ⑥ tested her in the way exams test people, by giving her something she could do, and she said that was the trouble with exams: they let you be good at something instead of asking what you would do if you were not.

The water in the village was ⑦ tested in 1987, after the third child in one street was ill, and the results were pinned to the door of the shop. Nobody read them. My mother ⑧ put the whole family to the test that winter by making us boil everything for eleven weeks, and we did it, and none of us was ill, and she never once said why.

The ⑨ test my sister did not sit was the one in June, the one that would have taken her to the city. She stayed, and for eleven years she said she had chosen, and I believed her, and then in 1998 she said the truth: the ⑩ test was never the exam in the hall but the nine days by the telephone, and she had already failed it, and everything after that was only arithmetic.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 考验；检验（品格、决心等）
D. n. 试验；测试（科学／技术）
F. v. 考验；使受考验
G. v. 检测；化验（水、血样等）
H. 固定搭配：put ... to the test 使……经受考验

items.q: There was a test on the Monday
our mother had had a test at the hospital
The test at the hospital was simple
the wait was not a test of anything
They tested us at school every week
It tested her in the way exams
The water in the village was tested
My mother put the whole family to the test
The test my sister did not sit
the test was never the exam in the hall

answers.why: a test 意为“测验、考试”，周一有一场考试，全班都复习了一个月。
a test 意为“（医学）检查、化验”，母亲在医院做了一次检查。
the test 意为“（医学上的）化验、检测项目”，医院的那项检查很简单：十一支小瓶、一个数字、九天等待。
a test of ... 意为“对……的考验”，她说那九天的等待不是对任何东西的考验，只是坐着不动。
tested 是动词，意为“测验、考查”，学校两年来每周都测验我们。
tested 意为“考验”，考试以给人一件擅长的事的方式考验她。
was tested 意为“被检测、被化验”，1987 年村里的水被检测过一次。
put ... to the test 意为“使……经受考验”，那年冬天母亲让我们全家把什么都煮沸，使全家经受了一次考验。
the test 意为“考试”，姐姐没有参加的那场考试是六月那场。
the test 意为“考验”，她说真正的考验从来不是大厅里那场考试，而是电话旁的九天。
